tasks.assertion: Verify complete the neutral OpenSpec proposal, seven capability specs, architecture decisions, phased delivery, acceptance gates, and pre-mortem without changing implementation code.

Verify create one ProjectAtlas GitHub feature issue that uses only ProjectAtlas vocabulary and links, describes the accepted target behavior, states that implementation has not started, and contains only ProjectAtlas-owned public artifacts and links.
Verify add `advance-rust-repository-intelligence` and its issue number to `openspec/issue-map.json`.
Verify mirror every checkbox in this file, including state and order, into the issue under `OpenSpec Task Checklist`.
Verify run strict OpenSpec validation and `.github/scripts/issue-checklists.py` after the issue and map exist.

Verify verify the public planning diff contains only publishable OpenSpec and issue-map artifacts and no non-publishable artifact, non-ProjectAtlas source identity/link/commit, Rust, Cargo, schema, fixture, runtime, or release implementation changes; keep evaluation evidence only in ignored local ProjectAtlas state.

The binding registry passes, while empty inventories, duplicate capability IDs, blank owners, unknown packs, empty public surfaces, empty fixtures, blank acceptance rules, and a reduced four-platform matrix all fail without trusting a copied capability total.

The valid pending candidate passes, while count-only parity, a missing required entry, duplicate IDs, fake aliases, absent fixtures/owners/platforms, inconsistent shared-parser ownership, count-preserving fake parser reuse, unsupported claims, and current-mode shrinkage all fail.

The valid ten-family registry and its per-capability ownership/acceptance data pass; removing a required family, installing the optional semantic pack by default, or making default core optional fails.

Every frozen CLI row and MCP tool matches the compiled surface, all invocable commands/tools map to recorded schema/default families, artifact/revision digests and behavior evidence reconcile, normal workflows add zero mandatory graph calls, and complete execution defaults plus later exact field/type, error, and hosted replay gaps remain explicitly partial.

The single authoritative manifest is fail-closed and non-vacuous: it binds source, Cargo.lock, runner, executable, command, environment, configuration, corpus, experiment, containment, and result-schema identities; distinguishes declared from observed toolchain and host evidence; and retains a no-claim state until eligible measurements exist.

The baseline contract retains pending evidence for ARRI-2.6, contains no observed measurements or future candidate commit, and leaves every eligible calibration baseline median unset until the final campaign.

The contract fixes the accepted record-family and comparison inventories, exact unstable-field exclusions, stable-identity and first-difference rules; the executable canonicalizer then normalizes entity/relation paths, line endings, object keys, and record order so full and incremental snapshots compare equal while the first semantic relation difference remains actionable.

The typed owner and machine contract agree on every budget ID, hard ceiling, unit, and enforcement status; resolution-candidate retention is runtime-enforced, unfinished resources remain advisory, caller configuration cannot promote advisory status, and wrong values, false status, or duplicate rows fail.

The parser and semantic pack budgets are separate, disabled and removable by default, cannot borrow default-core allowance, contain the exact positive hard-limit field catalog, and remain preregistered-not-measured.

The complete pre-result statistical manifest passes; obsolete ordering identity or encoding, insufficient paired or cold samples, best-run selection, generic superiority margins, missing five-point agent-quality improvement, and missing negative denominators fail.

Distinct raw SQLite, service, and MCP goals, measured transport and execution components, before-and-after calibration, the fixed tolerance ceiling, repetitions, timeouts, and pending eligibility remain exact and fail closed.

The feasibility FTS5/trigram differential is eligible and non-vacuous; literal candidates are a complete superset joined back to authoritative content, exact rows and order match, required fallback classes remain correct, equivalent transactional updates restore canonical source and FTS contents exactly, and the manifest-bound result schema retains sample identity, deterministic pair order, every raw paired request timing, paired update timings, paired checkpointed storage, checked incremental FTS bytes, and p50/p95 metrics derived from the retained requests.

The exact twelve-cell matrix is unique, deterministic, and non-vacuous; every cell commits its registered prepublication load transactions, records the load-source scope/count/bytes/timing, publishes replacement plus reconciliation plus slot/epoch flip in one RAII transaction, rolls injected failure back to both prior slots and metadata, preserves authored rows, retains the previous active slot after success, truncates WAL state, reconciles storage and both load/slot cleanup, and serializes every manifest-owned field.

The exact compiled native grammar set and versioned-WASM candidate are pinned to lockfile, fixture, manifest operation/profile/schema, metric, containment, ABI, portability, and blocker ownership contracts while all selection evidence remains pending; controlled omissions, unknown fields, ownership drift, and premature readiness fail.

Every pinned ANN and local-model candidate remains blocked pending labeled retrieval, deterministic model-input, vector-tolerance, integration, hosted-resource, and final measurement evidence; exact semantic metrics, licenses, package/platform/resource dimensions, checksums, and task owners are closed and controlled mutations fail.

The exact architecture topic inventory has unique nonempty decisions with closed accepted or provisional states, and only benchmark-dependent parser-host and optional-semantic choices remain provisional.
Every required semantic dimension has valid source, result-schema, and decision references; exact ID catalogs, derived group counts, and current blockers reconcile; rendering cannot hide failures.

Each non-pass state, a missing required dimension, or missing hosted evidence blocks final release acceptance; only the complete all-pass release fixture passes, while the independently tested four-gate Phase 0 contract remains no-claim and unaffected by deferred release evidence.

Public names remain frozen; only architecture, impact, and trace CLI/MCP surfaces are allowed; normal workflows add zero calls; optional packs remain disabled and removable; no speculative crate is permitted; response and workflow byte/token ceilings plus the four phase-exit dispositions are exact.

The review is mandatory at every phase exit; all seven scopes, four dispositions, record fields, disposition-specific completion requirements, and zero-blocker pass rule are exact; permissive mutations fail.
Every authoritative task and unique test ID materializes one complete initial row from one owner range; no pending row fabricates a successful command or result.
Every required invalid evidence class is fail-closed and implementation/final execution are assigned to #309 after stabilization.
The plan requires focused unit/risk layers in-slice and forbids coverage or full mutation before functional stabilization.
The catalog includes all valid, missing, stale, drift, dependency, retry, vacuity, and timeout fixtures without claiming they already executed.
Issues #308 and #309 are authoritative for their changes, checklists remain synchronized, and review/closure activation is owned by #309.
The host truth table accepts the current release blocker and rejects undeclared, missing, stale, or falsely passing provisioning evidence.
The selected projectatlas-cli owner and preservation state machine are accepted while malformed, missing, stale, or prematurely passing ownership is rejected.

Owned safety, locked dependency/build-script risk signals, known native boundaries, audit-tool gaps, and current advisory remediation are bound to exact evidence without claiming complete transitive unsafe/FFI coverage; malformed states, missing advisories, stale lockfiles, hidden inventory limits, and hidden containment blockers fail.

Exactly seven unique resolved reviewer roles cover the exact ten-finding Phase 0 ledger; every evidence path is normalized, repository-local, unique, and present; fixed findings have no deferral while narrowed/deferred findings have valid OpenSpec owners; every checked v0.4 task has an implemented task-specific test; no blocking finding remains open; no product/release claim is accepted; callable-variable identities retain qualified scope; and evaluator filter, concurrency, residual, path, executable-copy mode, and byte-limit policy remains fail-closed.

Issues 308 and 309, post-stabilization activation, independent nextest/doctest/LLVM coverage/source-mutation evidence, distinct repository-fault fixtures, and final documentation-before-IssueOps ordering agree across both OpenSpec changes regardless of task checkbox state; five contract mutations fail.
All 29 PM rows have unique stable IDs, concrete mitigation actions, and one or more references to existing ARRI tasks; missing actions, orphan rows, duplicate IDs, and unknown task references fail.

Exactly six existing product crates own the declared responsibilities and direct acyclic dependency edges reconciled from the live Cargo workspace; projectatlas-lints remains an independent workspace tool with no product-flow edge and projectatlas-index remains absent; unit and workflow tests retain their owning placement; first-touch-only splitting, no all-at-once refactor, and the demonstrated-boundary-plus-independent-consumer crate gate hold; missing owners, missing test ownership, duplicate/self/undeclared edges, a declared-owner multi-node cycle, speculative refactoring, and hypothetical crate ownership fail.

The focused core graph module preserves the complete four-variant legacy RelationKind conversion and exact serialized spellings without adding a parallel relation contract or speculative runtime abstraction.
